QUOTE: The default config turns off every threading option / "in the default configuration the library runs no threads and takes no locks" / "Concurrency exists only in the test and example programs"
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the library runs no threads by default, but it never says that a default build creates no threads at all, and it never says the pthread example compiles to a stub main; it describes ssl_pthread_server.c as spawning a pthread per connection.
